product.title: Best of Greenwich Private Day Tour

description.text: In London, Discover the cultural hub and maritime center of Greenwich on a full-day small-group walking tour including lunch. Step aboard the legendary Cutty Sark, visit the home of Greenwich Mean Time at the Greenwich Royal Observatory, visit the recently-renovated Queen's House, and tour the National Maritime Museum and the Old Royal Naval College. Stops include Cutty Sark, Royal Observatory Greenwich, Queen's House, National Maritime Museum, Old Royal Naval College, Greenwich Market. Browse for bargains at the lively Greenwich market, then tuck into a traditional pub lunch overlooking the River Thames. Ideal for visitors basing in London who want a guided city experience without coordinating Tube routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
